svg.text: rx_lobuf: LO buffer with enable (one per arm)
x = NAND2(in, en) -> the TX splitter on x (a = in, b = !in, edges pulled together by the keeper) -> two arms NAND2(., en) + 3 inverters: lo = in & en, lob = !in & en
arm inverters N 0.8/0.28 / 2/0.28 / 5/0.28 um; en = 0: x high, every mixer switch off, nothing after the first NAND toggles; source: sim/rx/rx_lo.py lobuf()
